title: osc.io
description: `osc.io` combines binary UDP OSC sending and receiving in one object, using an internal `netsend`, and can support either one-way or two-way communication with a back port. With no arguments it defaults to localhost port 9000; send `1`/`0` to connect/disconnect, or use `netaddr <ip> <port>` to change the destination after an automatic disconnect.
